body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Haier presented its new line of televisions, portable electronics and technologies at 2009 International Consumer Electronics Show(CES).
As an official HDTV of the NBA, Haier showed a broad array of high-definition LCD televisions, including new designs and features.
(picture : Clyde Drexler, Basketball Hall of Famer and 1995 NBA Champion visited Haier booth yestherday(8th))
< AVING Special Report Team for 'CES 2009' : Idea Kim, Min Choi, Kevin Choi, Joshua Shim, Paul Shin, Miso Kim, Esther Yoon, Abraham Shim, Grace Won, Risa Koo, JB Shim, Jini Shim >
